# Ilan Olivares — Web Design & Development, El Paso, Texas

> Ilan Olivares is an independent web designer and developer based in El Paso, Texas. He designs and hand-codes custom websites, website redesigns and landing pages, and provides local SEO, AI search visibility and website care for small businesses, churches, nonprofits, government and public agencies, medical practices, real estate, publications and personal brands. 10+ years of experience, 50+ projects launched. Clients work directly with Ilan from consultation through launch and support.

- Location: El Paso, Texas, USA
- Service area: El Paso, Horizon City, Socorro, Canutillo and Anthony, TX; Las Cruces, Sunland Park and Santa Teresa, NM; remote clients nationwide
- Contact: hello@ilanolivares.com or https://ilanolivares.com/contact/
- Free consultation; written proposal with scope and price before work begins

## Services
- [Custom website design](https://ilanolivares.com/services/custom-web-design/): Designed around your customers, coded by hand, fast on every phone. A site that looks like the real deal because it is.
- [Local SEO & AI search visibility](https://ilanolivares.com/services/seo/): Show up when El Paso searches on Google, Maps and Bing, or asks ChatGPT. Built into every site, and available on its own.
- [Website redesign](https://ilanolivares.com/services/website-redesign/): A dated or confusing site, rebuilt to look current and bring in inquiries without losing the rankings you've earned.
- [Landing pages](https://ilanolivares.com/services/landing-pages/): One page, one goal. For launches, events, programs and ads. I can also build from your Figma or Webflow design.
- [Website care & support](https://ilanolivares.com/services/website-care/): Updates, new pages, alerts and fixes, handled fast by the person who built it.
